historical_margins.notes: Equipment priced above competitors sold slowly and took up storage space.

competitor_trends.trend: Store brands of large sports chains set low prices on basics. Online marketplaces discount fitness equipment 5-10% in January, and equipment buyers compare several listings before buying.
